requirements.text: * PhD or MS with 2+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in operations research, robotics, controls, transportation, computer science, applied math, or a related field

* Deep expertise in at least one of: combinatorial/integer optimization, stochastic optimization or control, reinforcement learning/approximate DP, network flows, or marketplace/demand modeling, plus the curiosity to work across the rest
* Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
* Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
* Internship or research experience in ride-hailing, delivery, logistics, or AV fleets (dispatch, routing, rebalancing, pricing)
* Algorithms deployed in production or used on real operational data
* Publications in operations research, transportation, or robotics venues
